column1: # Inputs whose `unresolved` list is part of the conformance corpus (kind: unresolved).
# `unresolved=True` (the `?unresolved=true` API flag, off by default — see README,
# "Unresolved: measured, not guessed") names the words the ambiguity heuristic flagged
# and no stage resolved. Every other kind of case asserts converted TEXT; these assert
# the extra field a port's own heuristic — or lack of one — is free to compute
# differently while still producing byte-identical output, which is exactly the gap
# nothing else in the corpus would catch.
# direction  n2t = Narkamaŭka -> Taraškievica, t2n = the reverse
# Keep this file small, one case per direction at minimum: it exists to pin the
# `unresolved` contract, not to re-test conversion or measure precision — that is
# `pravapis eval --recall`'s job, on the full parallel corpus.
